retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1950s-style layout featuring a duotone subject isolated on white with asymmetric serif typography and a thin yellow frame.
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, white-background composition featuring a pink-tinted duotone figure seated cross-legged, balanced by large blue and pink serif text on the left, all enclosed within a thin yellow border.
coreVisualRelationships: Asymmetric balance between the right-aligned subject and left-aligned text blocks
Horizontal division created by a thin purple line and bow graphic
Color-coded hierarchy linking the subject's tint to the secondary text color
Negative space used to isolate the subject and enhance legibility
coreInvariants: Duotone pink treatment on the central figure

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is right-aligned, medium-full shot, seated cross-legged, occupying approximately 40% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large blue serif text in the upper-left quadrant acts as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the blue header down the purple dividing line to the pink sub-header, then right to the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounds all elements to maintain a clean, graphic look.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation for text and subject against a neutral white field; thin yellow border provides a bright frame.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to white, blue, pink, yellow, and purple.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders are kept short to allow for tight line spacing.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different colors and cases for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Thin purple horizontal line with a central bow knot
Pink shoelace graphic at the base of the subject

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, elegant serif look of the era.
Provides a slightly more traditional but still sharp serif alternative.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast duotone magenta portrait of a person seated cross-legged on a pure white background. Include a thin yellow border around the edge of the frame. Add a thin purple horizontal line across the middle with a simple line-art bow in the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large cornflower blue serif text in the top left quadrant and medium magenta all-caps serif text in the bottom left quadrant, ensuring tight leading and left alignment.

verificationChecks: Is there a thin yellow border?

mustRedesign: Ensure all text is generated as new vector-style typography

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on all graphics

postGenerationChecks: Check for color bleed between text and background
Verify the yellow border is continuous
Ensure the purple line is perfectly horizontal
Confirm the duotone effect preserves facial features
recipe.reuseFormula: White background + Duotone Subject (Right) + Serif Typography (Left) + Thin Border + Horizontal Divider.
